notes.title: Quantum Gravity Campaign
notes.notes:
Attention, adventurers! 

Brace yourselves for an electrifying expansion to the neon-styled bullet hell action game, Quantum Gravity! Ethernal Studio proudly presents "Cosmic Conquest," an adrenaline-fueled DLC that will take your space odyssey to unprecedented heights. Prepare to be captivated as you plunge into an exhilarating campaign mode that will push your skills to the limit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792938/117fe87d67b5764f9907477bb0e83595b8dfe01c.png[/img]

[b]Campaign Mode: Unleash the Adventure[/b]
Prepare for an immersive and challenging campaign experience like no other. From daring hostage rescues to target annihilation and mind-bending puzzles, Campaign Mode delivers a diverse range of gameplay encounters. Immerse yourself in an ever-evolving journey, as updates and events breathe new life into the campaign. With the intensity of a bullet hell shooter and the infinite replayability of an ever-changing landscape, the campaign will keep you enthralled for countless hours.

With intuitive controls and a logic that welcomes players of all skill levels, Quantum Gravity remains the perfect gaming experience. Whether you seek casual enjoyment or crave a formidable challenge, Quantum Gravity's "Cosmic Conquest" DLC has something for everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792938/83fea5b4be837d599c1ef5956e1e346add027485.png[/img]

In "Cosmic Conquest," you'll embark on an intergalactic journey like never before. Engage in heart-pounding battles against a formidable array of enemies, including challenging bosses and fierce melee combatants. Your survival instincts and mastery over the game's mechanics will be put to the ultimate test. Can you rise to the challenge and conquer the cosmos?

But that's not all! "Cosmic Conquest" also introduces a host of exciting features that will enhance your Quantum Gravity experience. Let's take a look:

[b]Infinity Mode: Push Your Limits[/b]
For those seeking an unparalleled test of skill, Infinity Mode is your calling. Brace yourself for infinite levels of escalating difficulty that will keep your adrenaline pumping. With each level more challenging than the last, Infinity Mode will push you to your limits. How far can you go in this hardcore mode? Prove your mettle and rise above the competition!

[b]Unleash Your Style: Customization Galore[/b]
Express your individuality with our extensive customization system. Utilize in-game credits to upgrade your health, ammo, and damage capabilities. Choose from a stunning selection of over 15 unique skins to personalize your gameplay experience. Stand out from the cosmic crowd and make your mark in Quantum Gravity's vibrant universe.

[b]Gravity Mode: A Twist of Fate[/b]
Prepare for a mind-bending adventure as Gravity Mode flips the script on traditional gameplay. Engage in an intricately complex experience as you manipulate gravity itself. In this mode, the player's mechanics and the gravitational forces surrounding you are inverted, demanding strategic planning and precise execution. Navigate treacherous environments and combat enemies with newfound challenges. Adapt or perish—this is Gravity Mode.

[b]Multiplayer Mayhem: Rise to the Challenge[/b]
Challenge your friends and embrace the excitement of thrilling PvP rounds with up to 7 players. Engage in dynamic and customizable multiplayer battles where every match brings fresh surprises. Unleash your skills, outsmart your opponents, and emerge victorious. The Multiplayer Mode offers endless possibilities, allowing each player to modify the rules and create unique game modes that will keep you coming back for more.

So, what are you waiting for

notes.title: Player Remastered
notes.notes:
Attention Quantum Gravity players, it's time to get excited! We are thrilled to announce the Network Player Remastered update, which completely rebuilds the whole network player to make it more efficient, functional, and visually stunning than ever before.

This update brings a host of improvements to Quantum Gravity, including reduced lag, improved functionality, and a brand new look that is sure to take your breath away. We've listened to your feedback and have made significant improvements to the network player to create a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience for everyone.

The new and improved network player boasts better performance, making gameplay even more responsive and immersive. We've also added a range of new functionalities that make it easier than ever to customize your gameplay experience. Choose from over 15 different skins to personalize your character and upgrade your health, ammo, and damage with in-game credits.

But that's not all! With Quantum Gravity's Infinity Mode, you can now push your skills to the limit with infinite levels that increase in difficulty. Battle against a wide variety of enemies, including bosses and tough melee combatants, and see how far you can make it in this hardcore game mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792938/ff9ce301dcd16bd0ea965d85ffc05c3fde5c29e4.png[/img]

And for those who are looking for a new challenge, the Gravity Mode adds a whole new dimension to Quantum Gravity's gameplay. In this mode, you can invert the player's mechanics and the gravity of the objects around you, creating a uniquely complex experience that requires careful planning and strategy.

The multiplayer mode has also been improved, allowing you to challenge your friends and compete in thrilling PvP rounds with up to 7 players. The mode is fully customizable, and each client can modify it to create new and interesting game modes.

Finally, embark on a challenging campaign featuring unique and engaging levels with Campaign Mode. From defending hostages to destroying targets and solving puzzles, Campaign Mode offers a wide range of gameplay experiences that will put your skills to the test.

With simple controls and logic that anyone can understand, Quantum Gravity is the perfect game for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun way to pass the time or a hardcore gamer looking for a challenge, Quantum Gravity has something for everyone.

So, what are you waiting for? Update your game, blast off into space, and start your adventure with Quantum Gravity today!

notes.title: Platforms + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, gamers! [/b]

Are you up for an exciting new journey? We're thrilled to share the news of our most recent game update, which will enhance your gameplay experience with a variety of exciting new features and enhancements.

First off, we've expanded the variety of positions and rotations for our platforms, so each level will present a distinct and difficult setting to test your abilities. You'll undoubtedly run across new challenges and catches along the road whether you're jumping, sliding, or dodging your way through the game.


But that's not all; in response to your feedback, we've also made several significant bug changes to make the game more streamlined and entertaining than ever. 

And if you thought that was it, think again—in the [i][b]future release, we're also including new platform shapes! Prepare to maneuver through hexagons, T's, L's, and more as you face increasingly difficult stages.[/b][/i]

We're dedicated to giving you the finest gaming experience we can, and we anticipate that these updates will make your gameplay even more exciting and enjoyable. So why are you still waiting? See what fresh game adventures are waiting for you by updating right away.

So go and play Quantum Gravity

notes.title: EXTRA Skins + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that three new skins have just been added to the game, along with a few important bug fixes that will make your gaming experience smoother than ever before.

[b]Skins[/b]
The new skins are now available for purchase in the game's store, and we are sure that you will love their unique designs and eye-catching details. Whether you prefer a sleek and modern look, a more playful and colorful style, or a classic and timeless appearance, there is a skin for every taste and preference.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
But that's not all! We have also fixed a number of bugs and glitches that were causing frustration and inconvenience for many of our players. These include issues with connectivity, loading times, and user interface, among others. 

So what are you waiting for? Update your game now and check out the new skins. We can't wait to see you in action and hear your feedback. As always, happy gaming!
